text: Serve flag variations to different contexts using targeting rules based on context attributes
quote: This topic explains how to use flag targeting rules to serve flag variations to different contexts based on their attributes.

text: SDKs can pass any custom context attributes to LaunchDarkly for use in flag targeting
quote: LaunchDarkly SDKs can pass any context attributes you want to LaunchDarkly, where you can then use those attributes in flag targeting.

text: Target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices in addition to attributes
quote: In addition to targeting specific context attributes, you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.

text: Targeting rules express precedence and conditions across multiple context kinds
quote: Targeting rules are the mechanism for expressing precedence and conditions across multiple context kinds.

text: Set expiration dates on flag targeting so customers receive a flag only for a set period
quote: You can even set expiration dates for flag targeting if you know you only want customers to receive a flag for a specific period of time.

text: Convert targeting rules into reusable segments
quote: Converting rules into segments

text: Test changes to flag targeting
quote: Testing changes to flag targeting

text: Create unlimited feature flags and target them by user, segment, or rule
quote: Create as many feature flags as you need and target them by user, segment, or rule.

text: Create and manage progressive rollouts that release features incrementally
quote: This topic explains how to create and manage progressive rollouts to release new features incrementally.

text: Percentage rollouts of flag variations
quote: Percentage rollouts

text: Guarded rollouts increase traffic progressively while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until 100%
quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until the rollout reaches 100%.

text: Autopilot ships agent-written code safely and rolls it back automatically if it breaks
quote: Your agents write the code. Autopilot ships it safely, and rolls it back if it breaks.

text: Request approval for flag changes from a member or team before they apply
quote: they have the option to request approval for that change from a member or team in their LaunchDarkly project.

text: Running log of changes to flags and other resources in each environment
quote: LaunchDarkly keeps a running log of changes made to feature flags and other resources in each environment. You can also use the change history to roll back a flag

text: Roll back a flag to a previous version from the change history
quote: You can also use the change history to [roll back](/docs/home/releases/version-restore) a flag to a previous version.

text: Schedule changes to a flag's targeting rules for future points in time
quote: Scheduling flag changes lets you define and schedule changes to your flag's targeting rules for future points in time.

text: Adaptive triggers for flags
quote: Adaptive triggers

text: Run A/B tests and experiments on flags
quote: A/B Tests and Experiments

text: Measure experiment metrics like page views, clicks, load time, and infrastructure costs
quote: You can measure things like page views, clicks, load time, infrastructure costs, and more.

text: Run experiments using data from an external warehouse such as Snowflake
quote: You can also run experiments using data from an external warehouse, like Snowflake.

text: Create numeric metrics from custom events, analyzed against a baseline you set
quote: You must use custom events to create numeric metrics, which measure and analyze numerical values against a baseline that you set.

text: Highlights the leading variation when there isn't yet enough data to declare a winner
quote: LaunchDarkly highlights the leading variation when there is not yet enough experiment data to declare a winning variation.

text: Experiment decisions use Bayesian statistics
quote: Decision making with Bayesian statistics

text: Environments let you manage flags from local development through production
quote: Environments allow you to manage your feature flags throughout your entire development lifecycle, from local development through production.

text: Create as many additional environments as needed
quote: You can create as many additional environments as you need.

text: Hosted MCP server lets you manage flags and AgentControl configs and view observability data from your AI client
quote: Configure the hosted MCP server so you can manage feature flags and AgentControl configs, and view observability data, directly from your AI client.

text: Manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language through the MCP server
quote: To get started with the LaunchDarkly MCP server, you enable the server, then use it to manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language.

text: MCP server works with MCP-capable clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot, and Windsurf
quote: you must have an AI client that supports MCP, such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf.

text: CLI to manage flags, members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources from the command line
quote: set up and manage your feature flags, account members, projects, environments, teams, and other resources directly from the command line.

text: CLI is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux
quote: The LaunchDarkly CLI is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

text: Relay Proxy is a Go app on your own infrastructure that proxies the streaming API connection to clients in your network
quote: a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients

text: Cloudflare SDK evaluates all flags at the edge for a context and bootstraps them into a cached payload
quote: The Cloudflare SDK gets all flags at the edge for a given context, and bootstraps them onto a cached payload

text: Cloudflare SDK can be used on its own starting with version 2.3.0
quote: If you are using Cloudflare SDK version 2.3.0 or later, you can use the Cloudflare SDK by itself.

text: 30 official SDKs: 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge
quote: 30 idiomatic SDKs 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge SDKs.

text: Official OpenFeature providers can be used in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK
quote: LaunchDarkly offers official OpenFeature providers for several of our SDKs... You can use these providers in your application in place of a LaunchDarkly SDK.

text: Assign preset or custom roles directly to members, overriding their base role
quote: If a member is directly assigned a role, such as a preset role or a role that you create, that role is used instead of the member's base role

text: Scope API access tokens to restrict operations, e.g. read-only integrations
quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access

text: Webhooks send an HTTP POST to a configured URL when flags or other resources change
quote: When something changes, like when a feature flag is updated... LaunchDarkly sends an HTTP POST payload to the webhook's configured URL.

text: Code references for feature flags
quote: Code references

text: FedRAMP-compliant instance for US federal environments
quote: This instance is compliant with the United States government's Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP).

text: Free $0/month plan with unlimited seats and unlimited feature flags
quote: $0/ mo, forever... Unlimited seats... Unlimited feature flags

text: No per-seat pricing; pricing is based on usage
quote: No per-seat pricing. Invite your whole team; pricing is based on usage.

text: Includes session replay and error monitoring, with 5K replays and 5K errors per month
quote: 5K session replays and 5K errors /mo

text: Configure, evaluate, roll out, and observe AI features end to end
quote: Configure, evaluate, roll out, and observe your AI end to end

text: Track LLM requests and run online LLM-as-a-judge evals, recorded as AI Runs
quote: An AI Run is generated when you track an LLM request or run an online eval (LLM-as-a-judge).

text: Integrates with CI/CD, observability, and data tools to control release behavior in production
quote: Connect your CI/CD, observability, and data stack to control change behavior in production and continuously improve what works.
